18K likes, 184 comments - mumbaifoodjunkie on September 6, 2024: "This has to be the yummiest Vadapav in Mumbai !! 😍

Head over to Lataz Vadapav in Andheri if you’re a fan of all things Vada Pav! 😋
From Classic to Cheese Burst vadapav to Tandoor vadapav – they’ve got it all! 🔥 

Perfect for a quick bite or a desi treat! ❤️

📍Location: Near Hubtown Solaris, Kanoji Angre Rd, Sai Wadi, Andheri East, Mumbai-53
